# Inset Shadow

3 tokens in the `inset-shadow` group.

| Token | Type | Value | CSS Variable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `inset-shadow.2xs` | `shadow` | `inset 0px 1px 0px 0px #0000000d` | `--rw-inset-shadow-2xs` | 2X small inset shadow |
| `inset-shadow.sm` | `shadow` | `inset 0px 2px 4px 0px #0000000d` | `--rw-inset-shadow-sm` | Small inset shadow |
| `inset-shadow.xs` | `shadow` | `inset 0px 1px 1px 0px #0000000d` | `--rw-inset-shadow-xs` | Extra small inset shadow |
